assumptions.source: Bryant operating memory and SDLC master rules
assumptions.statement: Codex may choose repo, branch, worktree, tests, agents, and QA logistics without asking Bryant.
The normalized task brief is the source of accepted behavior unless repo docs provide stronger evidence.

Risk tier `high` requires proof: red_green_test_log, fresh_verification_commands, code_review_artifact, release_gate, evidence_pack, backend_or_cli_proof_script, data_integrity_assertions, idempotency_replay_test.

questions.answer: Deploy latest main to persistent demo without resetting data; add UA student signup and real Stripe sandbox checkout on demo; configure billing credentials and webhook; execute live end-to-end QA
questions.question: What user-visible or system behavior must change?

questions.answer: Unrelated refactors, unrelated product behavior, production/customer data mutation, and merge/deploy actions.
questions.question: What is outside the scope unless evidence proves it is required?

questions.answer: red_green_test_log, fresh_verification_commands, code_review_artifact, release_gate, evidence_pack, backend_or_cli_proof_script, data_integrity_assertions, idempotency_replay_test
questions.question: Which proof will be required before reporting done?

questions.answer: superpowers:brainstorming, superpowers:writing-plans, superpowers:test-driven-development, superpowers:verification-before-completion, superpowers:requesting-code-review, sdlc-run-ledger, sdlc-evidence-pack, sdlc-backend-proof

reasons: Auth/security/billing/data/webhook work can create customer-impacting regressions.
Production rollout intersects with sensitive behavior.
